newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Give up ground to the bloc.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Give up ground to the bloc.

text.p: The Australian bond market generally underperformed against the dollar bloc in the wake of Wednesday's Japanese Tankan survey, apart from the long end differential to the U.S.
The survey was far stronger than forecasts at plus seven on the key diffusion index, and brought forward expectations of tighter policy in Japan, albeit from extremely low levels.
The data put pressure on the U.S. dollar and U.S. Treasuries in Tokyo, and the local market was positioning itself for a further negative reaction in New York later on Wednesday.
Domestic bonds continue to feed off developments offshore in the absence of any local data and as a local policy easing is more or less factored in ahead of next week's Reserve Bank's board meeting.
The U.S. market sees May U.S. durable goods orders and a US$15.0 billion five-year note sale on Wednesday.

The New Zealand market attracted some profit-taking after its recent firm performance in front of Thursday's budget and Friday's RBNZ monetary policy statement, but still outperformed Australia on the day.
